table.retrieve:
SELECT
	InstallmentHeader.InstallmentCode, 
	SaleInvCode = InstallmentHeader.SaleInvCode,
	InstallmentHeader.Date,
	AliasName = Accounts.AliasName,
	InstallmentHeader.CustCode,

	ResAddress = C.Address1,
	OffAddress = C.OffAddress,
	AddressStatus = C.AddressStatus,
	Occupation = C.Occupation,
	NIC = C.NIC,
	Phone = C.Phone,
	OffPhone = C.OffPhone,
	
	InstallmentHeader.GCode,
	GodownStock=0.0000,
	CustomICode = Item.CustomICode,
	InstallmentHeader.ICode, 
	InstallmentHeader.PackUnits, 
	InstallmentHeader.Qty, 
	InstallmentHeader.SalePrice, 
	InstallmentHeader.ItemFlatDisc, 
	InstallmentHeader.DiscPerc, 
	MarkupPerc = ROUND((InstallmentHeader.MarkupAmt / CASE WHEN ROUND((InstallmentHeader.Qty * (InstallmentHeader.SalePrice - InstallmentHeader.ItemFlatDisc) * ( 1 - InstallmentHeader.DiscPerc * 0.01)), 2) > 0 THEN ROUND((InstallmentHeader.Qty * (InstallmentHeader.SalePrice - InstallmentHeader.ItemFlatDisc) * ( 1 - InstallmentHeader.DiscPerc * 0.01)),2) ELSE 1 END) * 100, 2),
	InstallmentHeader.MarkupAmt, 
	ProcessingFeePerc = ROUND((ProcessingFee / CASE WHEN ROUND((InstallmentHeader.Qty * (InstallmentHeader.SalePrice - InstallmentHeader.ItemFlatDisc) * ( 1 - InstallmentHeader.DiscPerc * 0.01)), 2) + InstallmentHeader.MarkupAmt > 0 THEN ROUND((InstallmentHeader.Qty * (InstallmentHeader.SalePrice - InstallmentHeader.ItemFlatDisc) * ( 1 - InstallmentHeader.DiscPerc * 0.01)), 2) + InstallmentHeader.MarkupAmt ELSE 1 END) * 100, 2), 
	InstallmentHeader.ProcessingFee, 
	DownPaymentPerc = ROUND((InstallmentHeader.DownPayment / CASE WHEN (ROUND((InstallmentHeader.Qty * (InstallmentHeader.SalePrice - InstallmentHeader.ItemFlatDisc) * ( 1 - InstallmentHeader.DiscPerc * 0.01)), 2) + InstallmentHeader.MarkupAmt + InstallmentHeader.ProcessingFee) > 0 THEN (ROUND((InstallmentHeader.Qty * (InstallmentHeader.SalePrice - InstallmentHeader.ItemFlatDisc) * ( 1 - InstallmentHeader.DiscPerc * 0.01)), 2) + InstallmentHeader.MarkupAmt + InstallmentHeader.ProcessingFee) ELSE 1 END) * 100, 2), 
	InstallmentHeader.DownPayment, 
	InstallmentHeader.InstallmentFrequency, 
	InstallmentHeader.NoOfInstallments,
	InstallmentHeader.FirstDueDate,
	InstallmentHeader.UserCode,
	InstallmentHeader.Remarks,
	InstallmentHeader.Posted, 
	InstallmentHeader.PostedBy,
	InstallmentHeader.PostDate,
	InstallmentDate=InstallmentDetail.Date,
	InstallmentAmount=InstallmentDetail.Amount,
	AmtReceived=InstallmentDetail.AmtReceived,
	Discount=InstallmentDetail.Discount,
	Fine=InstallmentDetail.Fine,
	RowID=InstallmentDetail.RowID,
	Approved = InstallmentHeader.Approved,
	ApprovedBy = InstallmentHeader.ApprovedBy,
	ApprovedOn = InstallmentHeader.ApprovedOn
FROM
	InstallmentHeader, Accounts, Item, InstallmentDetail, Customer C
WHERE
	InstallmentHeader.InstallmentCode = :ai_code AND
	InstallmentHeader.CustCode = C.CustCode AND
	InstallmentHeader.CustCode = Accounts.AccCode AND
	InstallmentHeader.ICode = Item.ICode AND
	InstallmentHeader.InstallmentCode = InstallmentDetail.InstallmentCode
ORDER BY
	InstallmentHeader.InstallmentCode ,
	InstallmentDate,
	RowID

objects.name: t_10
objects.text: if( saleinvcode > 0 and posted='Y', 'Installment Schedule (Posted)', If(approved = 'Y', 'Installment Schedule (Approved)', 'Estimated Installment Schedule'))

objects.name: c_balanceamt
objects.expression: 'Balance: ' + STRING(Round((qty * (saleprice - itemflatdisc) ) * (1 - discperc * 0.01), 2)  + markupamt  + processingfee - downpayment, '##,###,##0.00')
